system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Prompt hooks support context construction, compaction, and policy-aware prompt assembly.
system_prompt_style.note: agent.py imports SystemPromptBuilder, load_project_instructions (AGENTAO.md), skills and memory; line numbers of assembly not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: File tools inspect, create, or modify local artifacts. Shell tools execute commands within the configured working directory and optional sandbox. Search tools provide repository and content search.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Token tracking, LLM-summarized compaction, overflow recovery, file re-injection
context_compaction.note: Tool-output pruning not verifiable from evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the formatting phase converts tool results into model-readable messages

tool_call_format.note: OpenAI-compatible client with tool-call proposals; parser code not in evidence.

tool_count.note: Tool registry (register_builtin_tools) not included in evidence; only categories listed in paper Fig. 1.

edit_primitive.note: file_ops tool definitions not in evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: Schema-producing code not in evidence; MCP tools exist (translate protocol schemas).

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP (stdio / Streamable HTTP / SSE) for tools · ACP (stdio JSON-RPC) for full agents · plugin lifecycle

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The runner constructs model context, invokes the LLM client through a provider-neutral interface, receives assistant messages and tool-call proposals, and delegates executable actions to the tool runner.

multi_agent_topology.note: Line approximate; sub-agents (codebase-investigator/generalist, custom .agentao/agents) reachable -> orchestrator_workers; CLI factory may enable them.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: A parent agent can delegate a bounded task to a child agent, either foregrounded or backgrounded depending on the host workflow.
delegation_mechanism.note: Custom .agentao/agents are loaded unconditionally in CLI; builtin agents off by default in constructor.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: A session contains conversation state, task metadata, active permissions, memory references, and replay pointers.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: SQLite-backed persistent memory with two scopes (user / project), automatic recall, jieba 中文 segmentation
long_term_memory.note: SQLite memory store coded episodic_db as closest value (it stores memory records, not trajectories); skills auto-discovered from skills/.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Context never silently dropped: LLM-summarized compaction, automatic memory recall, conversation continuity across restarts.
state_persistence.note: Paper Sec. 4.6: sessions can be paused, resumed.

self_verification.note: No verification component visible; run loop code truncated.

retry_policy.note: Chat loop code not in evidence.

rollback.note: File tool definitions not in evidence.

cost_controls.note: LLM config code not in evidence.

timeouts.note: Shell tool code not in evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Shell tools execute commands within the configured working directory and optional sandbox.
execution_isolation.note: Optional macOS sandbox-exec; sandbox_policy default None in agent.py.

filesystem_access.note: Default mode workspace-write per CLI toolbar fallback; host filesystem.

network_policy.evidence_quote: prompt for broad shell or network actions
network_policy.note: Network gated by confirmation, not disabled.

permission_model.evidence_quote: The policyP is composed from multiple sources: hardline safety checks, per-run restrictions, user or host rules, permission-mode presets, and tool-level defaults.

replayability.evidence_quote: Replay is implemented as an append-only event timeline.

eval_hooks.note: Repository tree not searchable in evidence.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Pre-tool hooks can deny a proposed action, downgrade an allowed action to confirmation, or inject project-specific restrictions.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Agentao shares the concern for local files and shell-mediated actions, but generalizes beyond coding tasks.

open_source.evidence_quote: Open source. Use and modify as needed.
open_source.note: LICENSE file not in evidence; OSI licence unconfirmed.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: For Anthropic / Gemini / DeepSeek / any OpenAI-compatible provider
